🧵 The 3-Question AI Readiness Test:

I've talked to 50+ SMB owners about AI.

The ones seeing results all answered YES to these 3 questions:

👇
followUps:
1/ Do you repeat this task weekly?

If it happens daily → High automation potential
If weekly → Medium potential
If monthly → Probably not worth it yet

2/ Does it follow a pattern you could explain?

Example: 'I check leads, prioritize by budget, send intro email'

If you can explain the steps → AI can learn them

3/ Would a 10% improvement matter?

10% faster response time = more conversions
10% less time = hours back per week

Compound that over a year.

schedule.text:
Hot take: AI strategy is overrated.

Most SMBs don't need an 'AI strategy.'

They need ONE task automated this week.

Strategy is what you build after you ship.

Client win this week:

❌ Before: 2 hours/day on lead follow-up
✅ After: 15 min/day + AI handles rest

Result:
• 40% faster response time
• 3x more meetings booked
• 10 hours/week saved

The AI didn't replace them. It amplified them.

What is your biggest blocker with AI right now?

A) Do not know where to start
B) Tried tools that didn't deliver
C) Worried about cost/ROI
D) Team resistance to change

Reply A/B/C/D — I will share specific resources.

🧵 AI Myth #2: 'You need to be technical to use AI agents'

Reality: The best AI tools are conversational.

You describe what you want.
The agent figures out how to do it.

No coding required.

Here is proof 👇
followUps:
1/ Example: Email triage

'ClawdBot, scan my inbox hourly, flag urgent items, summarize newsletters'

Done. No code written.

The AI understood intent and executed.

2/ Example: Content calendar

'Draft 7 tweets about AI automation for SMBs, schedule them evenly'

Result: 7 on-brand tweets, scheduled.
Time saved: 2 hours.

3/ The shift:

Old AI: Learn to code → Train models → Build systems
New AI: Describe outcome → AI builds → You approve

Barrier to entry: Zero.

4/ The real skill:

Not knowing HOW to build AI.
It's knowing WHAT to automate.

That's the 10-20 examples that matter.
That's the signal.

5/ SMB owners: You do not need an AI team.

You need an AI assistant that learns your business.

Start with one task.
Build from there.

That's the Clawdbot approach.
